description: This Java source file defines a class 'LoanTransactionMerchantIssuedRefundPostBusinessEvent' which extends 'LoanTransactionBusinessEvent'. It represents a specific business event related to loan transaction refunds issued by a merchant, within the Fineract project. The class contains a constructor to initialize the event with a 'LoanTransaction' object and overrides a method to return the event type.

classes.name: LoanTransactionMerchantIssuedRefundPostBusinessEvent
classes.description: Represents a business event triggered after a merchant issues a refund for a loan transaction in the Fineract system.
